propositions: Repository-wide audit of documentation and source comments against operator standards for prose, diction, formal voice, and structure must establish baseline conformance before remediation work begins.

Three exploration shards (durable records, external documentation, developer comments) with precedence rules and filtering passes must validate evidence quality, factual accuracy, placement, duplication, and conformance before adjudication.
Foundation items F01-F07 establish documentation ownership policy, prose remediation, validation infrastructure, and navigation prior to specific content corrections in the F08+ batch.
P0 accuracy and policy items must correct false guidance, missing user discovery, missing policy controls, and client-facing references before lower-priority cleanup.
Generated artifacts and derived outputs require canonical source identification and mechanical ownership tracking through descriptor protocol rather than repository-wide per-artifact registry.

Mechanical prose validation rejected where it risks false positives, but authoring guidance for punctuation, diction, tone, formal voice, and paragraph shape remains normative in documentation policy without deterministic gating.
